how_to_apply: Download the application form (proforma for the post of Senior Resident) from the IGIMS website.
Get a demand draft for Rs. 1000/- (Rs. 250/- for SC/ST) in favour of the Director, IGIMS, payable at Patna, and enter its details in the form.

Fill in the form: advertisement number, post and department, NMC/State Medical Council registration number, date of birth, category, addresses, qualifications starting from MBBS (marks, percentage and attempts), any experience after the MD/DNB, publications and presentations, and employment status. Attach a recent photograph and sign the declaration.
Report on 5 November 2026 at 09:00 AM to the Department of Anaesthesiology, First floor, near OT complex, IGIMS, Patna.
The filled application form, with photocopies of all supporting certificates and documents.
Originals proving age, qualifications, registration and the other details in the form.
Thesis and publications as a PowerPoint presentation on a pen-drive, plus a list of publications and presentations as per NMC guidelines, with reprints or certificates of presentations.

A No Objection Certificate from the employer for candidates employed in Government, Semi-Government or any other organisation. Without it, they will not be considered. Candidates who are not employed must state in writing that they are not employed anywhere and are not doing any course.
SC/ST: a caste certificate issued by the Circle Officer of the respective district/circle of Bihar, with a domicile certificate.
EBC (MBC)/BC: a caste certificate with exemption from the creamy layer, issued by the Circle Officer, if claiming reservation. EWS candidates need an EWS certificate issued by the Circle Officer.
A declaration stating whether you have filled in the Declaration form and appeared before the NMC Team for any medical college in the current year.

Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. The Director may reject or accept any application without giving a reason and may cancel the advertisement.

content_sections.heading: About IGIMS
content_sections.text: Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences is at Sheikhpura, Patna - 800014. Its letterhead describes it as an autonomous institute of the Government of Bihar and a statutory university created by an Act of the State Legislature, recognised by UGC and NMC. This notice was issued by the institute's Department of Anaesthesiology & Critical Care Medicine.

content_sections.heading: IGIMS Senior Resident Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice says the number of vacancies may increase or decrease. Reservation applies only to candidates with Bihar domicile. Applicants from outside Bihar do not get the benefit of reservation. Handicapped candidates get reservation as per Government of Bihar rules. Where a post is meant for a female candidate and no eligible woman is available, a male candidate may be considered. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: IGIMS Senior Resident Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation follows State Government rules: SC/ST: 05 years EBC (MBC) and BC: 03 years Female candidates of all categories: 03 years Persons working in a Government institution: relaxation as per rule A medical qualification included in Schedule I & II of the MCI Act. NMC-recognised P.G. qualification of MD/DNB in Anaesthesiology. Registration with the Central or a State Medical Council. Only Indian citizens can apply. These are minimum requirements and do not automatically make a candidate eligible for interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is the cost of the application form and is non-refundable. Candidates who download the form from the institute website must pay it by demand draft in favour of the Director, IGIMS, payable at Patna.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Selection Committee of the institute selects candidates based on their bio-data at the walk-in interview. Candidates must present their thesis and publications in PowerPoint and should bring them on a pen-drive. The committee's panel is valid for 06 (six) months only. Being selected on merit does not give a right to appointment, because the institute decides on appointing the candidates the committee recommends.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is under the 89 days Senior Residency programme. The posts are non-practising. Private practice of any kind, direct or indirect, including laboratory work, is prohibited, and an appointment will be terminated if this rule is broken. Selected candidates must sign a legal bond. If they quit or resign mid-way, they must pay one month's emoluments for every year of the Sr. Residency programme not completed. Living on campus is compulsory if accommodation is provided. If it is not provided, HRA is paid as per rule. Pay + NPA is paid, along with other allowances as per rule.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IGIMS Senior Resident Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The filled application form, with photocopies of all supporting certificates and documents. Originals proving age, qualifications, registration and the other details in the form. Thesis and publications as a PowerPoint presentation on a pen-drive, plus a list of publications and presentations as per NMC guidelines, with reprints or certificates of presentations. A No Objection Certificate from the employer for candidates employed in Government, Semi-Government or any other organisation. Without it, they will not be considered. Candidates who are not employed must state in writing that they are not employed anywhere and are not doing any course. SC/ST: a caste certificate issued by the Circle Officer of the respective district/circle of Bihar, with a domicile certificate. EBC (MBC)/BC: a caste certificate with exemption from the creamy layer, issued by the Circle Officer, if claiming reservation. EWS candidates need an EWS certificate issued by the Circle Officer. A declaration stating whether you have filled in the Declaration form and appeared before the NMC Team for any medical college in the current year.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the IGIMS Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 5 November 2026 at 09:00 AM at the Department of Anaesthesiology, First floor, near OT complex, IGIMS, Patna.

faq.question: Q2. How are the 06 posts divided among categories?
faq.answer: SC 02, ST 01, EWS 01, WBC 01 and EBC 01. Reservation is given only to candidates with Bihar domicile.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A medical qualification included in Schedule I & II of the MCI Act, an NMC-recognised MD/DNB in Anaesthesiology, and registration with the Central or a State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q4. How much age relaxation is given?
faq.answer: The upper limit is 45 years. It is relaxed by 05 years for SC/ST, 03 years for EBC (MBC) and BC, and 03 years for female candidates of all categories.

faq.question: Q5. How do I pay the application fee?
faq.answer: By a non-refundable demand draft for Rs. 1000/-, or Rs. 250/- for SC/ST, in favour of the Director, IGIMS, payable at Patna.

faq.question: Q6. What do I have to present at the interview?
faq.answer: Your thesis and publications, as a PowerPoint presentation. Bring it on a pen-drive.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: It is under the 89 days Sr. Residency programme. The Selection Committee's panel stays valid for 06 months.

faq.question: Q8. What happens if I leave the residency mid-way?
faq.answer: Under the legal bond, you must pay one month's emoluments for every year of the Sr. Residency programme not completed.

faq.question: Q9. I am currently employed. What extra document do I need?
faq.answer: A No Objection Certificate from your employer, submitted at the interview. Without it, you will not be considered for selection.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.
